counting_method: Image counts: unique filename stems under original image/ and image/{train,val,test}, extensions in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS. Annotation file counts: recursive files with .json/.xml/.txt under lables/. Instance counts: objects/shapes/lines parsed from each file. JSON LabelMe labels are the semantic class names used for per-class instance and image-containing-class counts. Image counts and instance counts are computed separately. Vendor train/val/test folders were recorded but not modified.

pascal_voc_xml.description: Pascal VOC XML with object/bndbox xmin ymin xmax ymax

yolo_txt.description: YOLO TXT class_id cx cy w h normalized to image size

class_mapping_observed.note: Derived by pairing objects in file order when JSON/XML/TXT instance counts matched. This is observed in this archive, not an official codebook file.

bounding_box_statistics.source: labelme_json rectangles converted to axis-aligned xyxy

duplicates.near_duplicate_definition: Potential near-duplicates: 8x8 average-hash Hamming distance <= 5, excluding confirmed exact MD5 duplicates. These are candidates only.
duplicates.note_on_two_image_folders: original image/ and image/{{train,val,test}} contain the same filename stems. Identical MD5 hashes mean two copies of the same file, not two distinct specimens.

grouping.method: Filename pattern d_d_dddd_dddd_NG with optional _partN or _full
